title: graphlearnR: Graph Machine Learning and Geometric Deep Learning in R
description: A native R framework for machine learning on graphs, built on the torch package without a Python dependency. Provides validated graph data structures with explicit 1-based indexing, conversions, mini-batching, scatter aggregation and message passing, graph neural network layers, pooling, neighbor sampling, leakage safe splits, heterogeneous and temporal graphs, graph transformers with structural encodings, a training loop for node, edge, link and graph tasks, evaluation metrics, and explanations.
